title: Book Two · Chapter 24: The Wrong Two Boxes
story:
On Wednesday, Jun puts the little card between their story copies.

“We have the people,” he says. “Now first and next.”

Ronan looks at the page. He remembers the bowl, the soup and the apples. He can say all those words quickly.

“I can tell it now.”

Jun holds his pencil above the second box.

“The woman lends the bowl,” Ronan begins. “The girl takes it home. Her mum puts soup in it. Then the girl takes the bowl back.”

“And lunch?” Jun asks.

“Lunch comes next. Then the woman gives her an apple.”

Jun looks at him. “She takes the soup back too?”

“Perhaps they put it in another bowl.”

“Does the story say that?”

Ronan looks towards Leo. His friend is already talking to his partner. Both of their story copies are open.

“It says bowl, and then lunch,” Ronan says. “I read it.”

Jun writes SOUP and BOWL BACK in the second box. He writes LUNCH and APPLE in the third. There is little space left for pictures.

Ronan begins a small bowl beside the words. Jun adds an apple below it. They must use only this one card today. Miss Wu is helping another pair at the back of the room.

Jun takes his turn. He uses the notes, but he stops at the bowl.

“The girl carries the soup home. No, the bowl home. Her mum puts soup in it. Then the girl takes it back. Is the soup still inside?”

“Just say the bowl.”

“But I need to understand it.”

Ronan feels cross. The task was going quickly before all these questions.

Jun puts his pencil down.

“Let us read that line.”

“The girl returns the bowl,” Ronan says.

Jun moves his finger further along the same line. There are two more words.

After lunch.

Ronan looks at them. He reads the whole sentence aloud.

“The girl returns the bowl after lunch.”

Jun turns the card towards him.

“Here we put the bowl back first.”

Ronan checks the page again. The word after is there. He left it out before.

“Lunch is first,” he says.

“Yes. That is different.”

Jun takes the rubber from his tin. He rubs out BOWL BACK. The grey mark spreads into the bowl picture. He stops and looks at it.

“I wanted to keep that clear.”

“I can rub it,” Ronan says.

“Wait. The paper is getting thin.”

Miss Wu calls for the cards. The lesson is ending. Jun tells her they need to change the order. She asks them to put the story page with the card.

“Do that part tomorrow,” she says. “Keep both pages together.”

Ronan gives her his copy too. He wants to say they were nearly finished. He says nothing about that.

At break, Jun goes outside with another child. Ronan stays by his desk for a moment. Then he follows them into the yard.

Jun throws the cloth ball to him. Ronan catches it. Now it is his turn. He throws the ball back carefully. Jun raises both hands.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- after lunch＝午饭之后
- order＝顺序
- spreads＝扩散开
- thin＝薄的

## 理解问题

1. Ronan漏掉的after怎样改变了故事顺序？
2. 错误说明给Jun的卡片造成了什么实际麻烦？

## 从认词到读句子

正文原句：*Jun turns the card towards him.*

**Jun / turns the card / towards him.**

Jun／把卡片转过来／朝向Ronan。him指Ronan。
